entities.name: Nafi ibn al-Harith
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nāfiʿ ibn al-Ḥārith ibn Kalada al-Thaqafī was an Arab physician of the Banu Thaqif. He was recommended by Muhammad, and treated Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas and Abu Bakr. When the latter was dying, he designated his illness as poisoning.
